name: Publishing House Bed & Breakfast
welcomeMessage: Handpicked by our innkeepers — the same spots we tell our regulars about.

recs.name: Big Star
recs.shortDescription: Walk-up taco window and a whiskey list that goes deep — the patio is the whole point in summer.
recs.staffNote: No reservations — put your name in and grab a drink at the bar next door while you wait.

recs.name: Emporium Arcade Bar
recs.shortDescription: Dozens of classic arcade games, pinball, and a great beer list — free to play once you're in.

recs.name: Antique Taco
recs.shortDescription: Inventive tacos in a cozy, plant-filled space — the brunch menu is worth the visit alone.

recs.name: Reckless Records
recs.shortDescription: A Chicago institution for used vinyl, CDs, and browsing longer than you planned to.

recs.name: Ukrainian National Museum
recs.shortDescription: A small, thoughtfully curated museum on Ukrainian art, folk life, and immigration history.
